top_signals.title: Kansai emerges as key data center hub as other regions vie for share
top_signals.summary: According to Fuji Chimera Research Institute, Kansai data centers occupy a total site area of about 1.16 million square meters — 25% of Japan's total.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
